about: Every input named in a decision step (data/decision-processes) mapped to a record, with where it can be had. status: on-site (the platform already holds it), online (public on the web, not yet brought in), records-request (exists but is not posted; ask the custodian), not-used (individual voter records the platform will not collect). format: api, csv, web, pdf, browser-only (blocks automated reads). Checked 2026-10-30.

items.name: Budget calendar
items.where: Each body's budget office; dates already in the platform's governance calendars (cycles)
items.note: Dates for 21 bodies are in the platform. The county posts its calendar by Jan 30.

items.name: Department business plans
items.where: County budget office (business plans and scorecards)
items.note: County only. Cities rarely publish department plans.

items.name: Department budget requests
items.where: Budget office (county Office of Management and Budget; city finance or budget office; school district budget office)
items.note: Internal drafts sent to the Mayor or Manager in the spring. Public records once written, but not posted.

items.name: Revenue forecast
items.where: Budget office
items.note: Spring forecasts are internal until the proposed budget is released in July, when a multi-year outlook is part of the county's proposed budget volumes.

items.name: Budget priorities and workshop direction
items.where: Workshop and retreat agendas, minutes and video in the body's agenda system
items.note: Whether it can be read by machine depends on the body's agenda system.

items.name: Certified taxable value (DR-420 figures)
items.where: Miami-Dade Property Appraiser: preliminary roll by taxing authority (July 1) and taxing authorities report
items.note: The values are posted. The signed DR-420 form each body returns is a records request to that body or the Property Appraiser.

items.name: Assessment roll
items.where: Property Appraiser property search and county parcel open data
items.note: Parcel by parcel. Also the source of the owner list for rezoning notices.

items.name: Proposed rates and hearing dates from every taxing authority
items.where: Property Appraiser taxing authorities report; each body's adopted proposed-millage resolution

items.name: TRIM notice (your proposed tax bill)
items.where: Property Appraiser, per property, mailed in August and searchable online

items.name: State funding estimates, enrollment and required local effort
items.where: Florida Department of Education FEFP calculations (each calculation lists every district)

items.name: Proposed or tentative budget and millage
items.where: Each body's website; state law requires the tentative budget online before the first hearing
items.note: s. 129.03(3)(c) and s. 166.241(3), F.S. Usually long PDFs.

items.name: Hearing notices and ads
items.where: Florida's statewide public notice website and the newspaper of record
items.note: s. 50.0211, F.S. Covers budget hearing ads, ordinance notices and rezoning display ads.

items.name: Adopted budget and millage resolutions
items.where: Each body's website (posted within 30 days of adoption) and the final hearing's agenda packet
items.note: Adopted rates by authority are also in the Property Appraiser's reports. The county's adopted vendor and staffing figures are already on this site.

items.name: TRIM compliance package (DR-487 with resolutions and ad copies)
items.where: Florida Department of Revenue, Property Tax Oversight; or the body's budget office
items.note: Filed with the state within 30 days of the final hearing (s. 200.068, F.S.). Not posted.

items.name: Agenda item with backup (ordinance text, staff report, memo, fiscal or business impact statement, committee recommendation)
items.where: The body's agenda system
items.note: Posted with each meeting's agenda. Machine-readable for 3 bodies (Legistar), partly for 13, and blocked for 5 (Cutler Bay, Miami Gardens, North Miami, South Miami, Sunny Isles Beach), which need a browser session or a records request.

items.name: Business impact estimate
items.where: The body's website, posted before the ordinance notice
items.note: Required since 2023 (s. 166.041(4) and s. 125.66(3), F.S.). Often only inside the agenda packet.

items.name: Who asked for an item, and its drafts
items.where: Clerk and the sponsor's office
items.note: The sponsor is named on the agenda item. Drafts, emails and requests to the attorney before it is filed are records requests.

items.name: Adopted ordinance or policy
items.where: Clerk's legislative files and the code of ordinances (Municode for most cities)
items.note: Votes on adopted items are already on this site for the county and the cities whose minutes have been read.

items.name: Written comments received
items.where: Clerk or board secretary
items.note: Sometimes added to the agenda packet; usually not.

items.name: Hearing record (minutes and video)
items.where: The body's agenda system and video archive
items.note: Votes by name already on this site where minutes give them.

items.name: Adopted budget or capital plan behind a purchase
items.where: County capital plan and expiring contracts (already on this site); school and city capital plans in their budget documents
items.note: On this site for the county, schools and Miami Beach (expiring contracts) and the county capital plan.

items.name: Department scope of work
items.where: Procurement office
items.note: Internal until it becomes the published solicitation.

items.name: Solicitation (bid or proposal request) and its scoring criteria
items.where: County supplier portal and future solicitations list; school district procurement site; city bid pages
items.note: County open and upcoming solicitations are partly on this site.

items.name: Sealed responses and evaluation score sheets
items.where: Procurement office
items.note: Confidential until the notice of intended decision or 30 days after opening (s. 119.071(1)(b)2, F.S.); public after that but rarely posted.

items.name: Committee ranking and award recommendation
items.where: County award recommendations page; agenda backup for the award vote; some cities post notices of recommendation

items.name: Negotiated contract terms
items.where: Agenda backup for the award vote

items.name: Bid protest and its outcome
items.where: Procurement office or clerk
items.note: Protest notices and hearing officer reports are not posted as a set.

items.name: Award and payments
items.where: County purchase orders on county open data (INFORMS); award items in agenda systems
items.note: County vendor totals from the budget are on this site; purchase order rows are an open API not yet brought in.

items.name: Qualifying papers and the list of qualified candidates
items.where: Supervisor of Elections and city clerks
items.note: Candidates on the Nov 3 ballot are on this site; qualifying documents are viewable on the county's campaign finance system.

items.name: Petition signatures for qualifying
items.where: Supervisor of Elections
items.note: Verification counts are reported; the petitions themselves are a records request.

items.name: Contributions, expenses and leftover campaign funds
items.where: County and some cities: Voter Focus (CSV); six cities: EasyVote; eight cities: scanned PDFs; state: Division of Elections; federal: FEC
items.note: Donations for candidates on the ballot are on this site. Termination reports (leftover funds) are online but not yet brought in. Eight cities post only scans.

items.name: Election results, recounts, runoff and top-two candidates
items.where: County election night reporting (results CSV) and canvassing board certificates
items.note: Ballot305's results job pulls Nov 3 results into the roster on a schedule.

items.name: Individual voter records (registration applications, mail ballot requests, ballots)
items.where: Supervisor of Elections
items.note: Not collected. Aggregate counts (registration totals, turnout) are online.
